baliUsername.title: Bali Username
baliUsername.description: Username from Bali Motorization mobile app.  It is recommended creating a new user in mobile app with "Basic User" permission levels since no Admin or Advanced permissions are required by this plugin.

baliGatewayId.title: Bali Gateway ID
baliGatewayId.description: The ID of your Bali Gateway device. This can be found in the Bali Motorization App on the main page when connecting to your Gateway. If no Gateway ID is entered here, the first one associated with your account is selected.

lowBattery.title: Low Battery percentage threshold
lowBattery.description: Default 33%. The percentage threshold at which the low battery status will be set on Homebridge blinds accessories.

requestTimeout.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeout.description: Default 10. How long to wait for the Bali Gateway to respond (connecting, logging in, or any command) before giving up and reporting an error, so a stuck connection can recover instead of hanging.

refreshInterval.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refreshInterval.description: Default 300 (5 minutes). How often to resync all blind positions and battery levels from the Bali Gateway, in case a live update was missed. This also keeps the connection fresh so commands aren't delayed by reconnecting. Set to 0 to disable.

targetGracePeriod.title: Target position grace period (seconds)
targetGracePeriod.description: Default 60. After a command from HomeKit, how long to keep showing that target position before following positions reported by the Bali Gateway (e.g. when a blind is moved with the Bali app or a remote).
